experiments.title: Dense temporal-history sweep
experiments.expected_diagnostic: task- and regime-dependent diminishing returns, without a universal memory constant
falsification_conditions: shuffled history improves equally
future samples enter a representation
all tasks share one optimum

experiments.title: Full 12-cell future-direction task battery
experiments.expected_diagnostic: mean and worst-cell objectives can select different representations
falsification_conditions: mean and worst-cell rankings are forced to agree
cell identity is discarded

experiments.title: Representation lattice comparison
experiments.expected_diagnostic: no ranking by mean AUC alone
falsification_conditions: representation names do not match algorithms
causal sufficiency is inferred from prediction

experiments.title: Task-law discrepancy and tolerance gate
experiments.expected_diagnostic: point estimate, bootstrap estimand and tolerance gate remain separate
falsification_conditions: bootstrap point replaces primary point
epsilon is selected after seeing results

experiments.title: Subject-level bootstrap uncertainty
experiments.expected_diagnostic: windows are resampled within subjects, subjects across replicates
falsification_conditions: windows are treated as independent subjects
interval is described as a causal interval

experiments.title: Independent 31-recording predictive transport
experiments.expected_diagnostic: independent cohort is not pooled with certification cohort
falsification_conditions: cohorts are pooled
transport is labelled causal or clinical validation

experiments.title: EO/EC and cross-regime transfer
experiments.expected_diagnostic: protocol and regime are preserved in the split
falsification_conditions: regime labels are discarded
future calibration data leak into training

experiments.title: Wearable CPAP Mayo/LBNP external stress family
experiments.expected_diagnostic: each source remains a separate validation or stress-test domain
falsification_conditions: source protocols are pooled without adaptation
unavailable records are imputed

experiments.title: NIRS optical-density raw proxy
experiments.expected_diagnostic: OD is retained as OD and is not relabelled HbT
falsification_conditions: OD is called HbT
source preprocessing is guessed

experiments.title: Network physiology association and surrogate analysis
experiments.expected_diagnostic: Pearson/MI association is separated from causality
falsification_conditions: association is labelled intervention
surrogate method is omitted

experiments.title: Semantic communication negative-control matrix
experiments.expected_diagnostic: decode can remain high while semantic fidelity falls
falsification_conditions: payload carries target labels
transport and semantics share one metric

experiments.title: Resource-conditioned capability
experiments.expected_diagnostic: resource-conditioned capability is distinct from intrinsic representation value
falsification_conditions: resource-conditioned and intrinsic estimands are merged

experiments.title: Independent support-function and joint-attainability correction
experiments.expected_diagnostic: coordinatewise maxima need not be jointly attainable
falsification_conditions: same-policy difference substitutes for support gap
coordinatewise optimum is reported as attainable

experiments.title: P0/P1/P2 resource physics and robust envelope
experiments.expected_diagnostic: P2 has coupled internal states and independent solver checks
falsification_conditions: scalar discharge is labelled P2
energy residual is ignored

experiments.title: Synthetic causal identification campaign
experiments.expected_diagnostic: valid assumptions recover truth and failed assumptions emit gates
falsification_conditions: prediction is called causal
positivity failure returns a definitive effect

experiments.title: PIV information-availability counterfactuals
experiments.expected_diagnostic: PIV is downstream utility, not confidence or packet importance
falsification_conditions: unpaired means are called PIV
observational contrast is promoted without identification

experiments.title: PIR/PIV loss decomposition
experiments.expected_diagnostic: L_total equals L_info plus L_policy under common references
falsification_conditions: controller value replaces actual optimum
PIR is reported without task/reference context

experiments.title: Historical cross-layer controller benchmark
experiments.expected_diagnostic: adaptive advantage is reward- and condition-dependent
falsification_conditions: reward proxy is treated as PIR definition
oracle and random baselines are omitted

experiments.title: Master scientific regression and release suite
experiments.expected_diagnostic: every result has a source, estimand, evidence class, seed and falsification condition
falsification_conditions: same implementation is used as sole independent validator
blocked external input is treated as reproduced
